scope: Read-only, non-elevated discovery of the existing Windows host. No Windows feature, VM, switch, service, policy, registry, security, execution-policy or installation state was changed.

execution_policy.persistence: None; Bypass applied only to the authorized discovery PowerShell process

hyper_v.systeminfo_observation: A hypervisor has been detected; requirement values are suppressed. Virtualization-based security is running with base virtualization support.
hyper_v.platform_feature_inventory: Win32_OptionalFeature returned no Microsoft-Hyper-V feature records on this Windows Home edition.
hyper_v.virtualization_wmi_provider: unavailable: root/virtualization/v2 is an invalid namespace
hyper_v.interpretation: The active Microsoft hypervisor/VBS substrate is not the supported Hyper-V VM role. Hyper-V VM management is not usable by the current account without changing the host.

processor.hardware_capability: Intel documents VT-x and VT-x with Extended Page Tables (EPT), which supplies SLAT, as supported.
processor.firmware_runtime_evidence: Windows reports an active hypervisor and running VBS base virtualization support. Win32_Processor returned false for firmware/monitor/SLAT booleans while the hypervisor was active; those suppressed values are not treated as a hardware failure.

external_switch.evidence: Get-VMSwitch is not installed and the Hyper-V virtualization WMI namespace is absent. No usable Hyper-V external-switch inventory or management plane exists on this host. No network state was changed.

support_basis.finding: Microsoft supports the Hyper-V role on Windows 11 Pro or Enterprise and explicitly excludes Windows 11 Home.

raw_record.commit_policy: Raw record remains ignored because it contains the local account name; this sanitized evidence omits it.

decision.minimal_owner_action: Provide access to a Windows 11 Pro or Enterprise host on which the Hyper-V platform and management tools are already enabled and the current account can manage Hyper-V. The current Windows 11 Home host cannot be made suitable by merely enabling the Hyper-V optional feature.
decision.next_check_after_owner_action: Repeat this read-only discovery, then inventory an existing external switch before any VM creation or network change.

gate_effect: Gate 5 and the clean-host portion of Gate 0 remain blocked. The frozen review2 ZIP has not been changed or executed in an independent guest.
